title: Lipgloss Phone Case
author: Emilio_31415
description:
A case for iPhone 14 pro max that is inspired by the phone case with lipgloss holder from Rhode. This is designed to hold “Clarins lip perfector” so lipglosses with a diameter of 15 mm should fit. Use super glue to glue the two parts together. The phone case is surprisingly comfortable to hold and the girlfriend is very happy:)
